schedules.task: Review the live website's main pages with review_site_page: the homepage (/), /services/, /about/ and /contact/. Check each page's title and meta description for accuracy, the services and location the page supports, and length. For the clearest improvement, submit up to two evidence-backed proposals using submit_seo_copy, each citing that page's action ID; skip a page whose wording is already suitable and never repeat wording that is already live. Record what you checked and recommend using post_seo_report with the page action IDs. Never publish: approved changes go to the website's Preview and staff publish them from the console.
